# Personal Launcher review notes

This repository maintains Personal Launcher, package `com.sadique.launcher`, for Android TV and Google TV.

- Describe the problem and the final behavior in each pull request.
- Keep changes scoped and preserve Home, remote, volume and recovery behavior.
- Run launcher unit tests, lint and release assembly for app changes.
- State whether a change was tested on a physical TV; do not claim device tests from CI alone.
- Keep versionName 7.0 unless the owner requests a version change; increment versionCode for app updates.
- Keep signing material and device/account identifiers out of commits.
- Send security reports privately to [sadique6571@gmail.com](mailto:sadique6571@gmail.com).

Changes and suggestions are welcome through GitHub issues or the same contact email.
